messages:
elaine: Heads up — prod telemetry just alerted: sudden increase in downstream cache misses and some services reporting TTL header == 0. Looks like a header-massaging regression from the gateway change we rolled last night.
rob: ugh. which route/policy?
elaine: Route: /api/v1/generate -> 'fast-path' had the new header override that strips `cache-control` for streaming. suspect interaction with CDN.
maya: can we flip to fallback route or re-add header quickly? quiet window in 20m so low traffic but still want safe plan.
josh: propose temporary switchover: set weight fast-path=0, fallback=1 for 15m, monitor. then incremental canary if stable.
elaine: agree. also add a telemetry tag so dashboards show TTL vs error bursts: `ingress.hotfix=ttl-safety`.
rob: I'll run the console toggle. @oncall-bot can you push a short policy change that sets `X-Force-Cache: enable` at egress for fallback route?
oncall-bot: ack — drafting patch, will post diff.
rob: patch posted: `service: gateway
routes:
  - name: fallback
    headers:
      X-Force-Cache: "enable"
`
maya: before the toggle, let's smoke test with replay tool: `./tools/replay.py --route=fallback --count=50` and validate latency/outputs.
josh: also create a quick alert rule: alert if 5xx rate > 0.5% OR cache-miss rate > 10% for 5m. Add to incident dashboard tab.
elaine: doing replay now — 50 requests, all responses OK, latencies within 95th p95 baseline.
rob: toggling weights: `redwoodctl routes set-weight fast-path 0` && `redwoodctl routes set-weight fallback 1` — executing in 3..2..
rob: done. routing table change propagated.
maya: telemetry: added tag + dashboard panel. early signals look good, cache-miss dropped ~70%.
josh: keeping canary window 15m then re-evaluate. rollback plan: set weights back to previous and revert header override config; playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/routing-rollback
elaine: filing quick postmortem and a follow-up action: console should show one-click "quiet-window switchover" with preflight checks (replay + telemetry). opened ticket #ENG-5421.
rob: note — need to ensure runbooks include `redwoodctl` commands and required perms. I nearly couldn't run set-weight until role check fixed.
maya: also recommend automatic telemetry tag injection on emergency toggles so we don't rely on manual dashboard edits.
oncall-bot: incident note: 2772468000 — routing switchover executed, fallback route engaged, brief spike mitigated.
elaine: thanks team. will keep monitoring for another 30m then we'll schedule the rollback/gradual rollout plan in next sync. :thumbsup:
